entries.title: Mark 2:1
segments: ¶And he entered again into Capernaum after [several] days, and it was reported that he was at [the] house;

entries.title: Mark 2:2
segments: and straightway many were gathered together, so that there was no longer any room, not even at the door; and he spoke the word to them.

entries.title: Mark 2:3
segments: And there come to him [men] bringing a paralytic, borne by four;

entries.title: Mark 2:4
segments: and, not being able to get near to him on account of the crowd, they uncovered the roof where he was, and having dug [it] up they let down the couch on which the paralytic lay.

entries.title: Mark 2:5
segments: But Jesus, seeing their faith, says to the paralytic, Child, thy sins are forgiven [thee].

entries.title: Mark 2:6
segments: But certain of the scribes were there sitting, and reasoning in their hearts,

entries.title: Mark 2:7
segments: Why does this [man] thus speak? he blasphemes. Who is able to forgive sins except God alone?

entries.title: Mark 2:8
segments: And straightway Jesus, knowing in his spirit that they are reasoning thus within themselves, said to them, Why reason ye these things in your hearts?

entries.title: Mark 2:9
segments: Which is easier, to say to the paralytic, [Thy] sins are forgiven [thee]; or to say, Arise, and take up thy couch and walk?

entries.title: Mark 2:10
segments: But that ye may know that the Son of man has power on earth to forgive sins, he says to the paralytic,

entries.title: Mark 2:11
segments: To thee I say, Arise, take up thy couch and go to thine house.

entries.title: Mark 2:12
segments: And he rose up straightway, and, having taken up his couch, went out before [them] all, so that all were amazed, and glorified God, saying, We never saw it thus.

entries.title: Mark 2:13
segments: ¶And he went out again by the sea, and all the crowd came to him, and he taught them.

entries.title: Mark 2:14
segments: And passing by, he saw Levi the [son] of Alphaeus sitting at the tax-office, and says to him, Follow me. And he rose up and followed him.

entries.title: Mark 2:15
segments: And it came to pass as he lay at table in his house, that many tax-gatherers and sinners lay at table with Jesus and his disciples; for they were many, and they followed him.

entries.title: Mark 2:16
segments: And the scribes and the Pharisees, seeing him eating with sinners and tax-gatherers, said to his disciples, Why [is it] that he eats and drinks with tax-gatherers and sinners?

entries.title: Mark 2:17
segments: And Jesus having heard [it] says to them, They that are strong have not need of a physician, but those who are ill. I have not come to call righteous [men], but sinners.

entries.title: Mark 2:18
segments: ¶And the disciples of John and the Pharisees were fasting; and they come and say to him, Why do the disciples of John and [the disciples] of the Pharisees fast, but thy disciples fast not?

entries.title: Mark 2:19
segments: And Jesus said to them, Can the sons of the bride-chamber fast while the bridegroom is with them? As long as they have the bridegroom with them they cannot fast.

entries.title: Mark 2:20
segments: But days will come when the bridegroom shall have been taken away from them, and then shall they fast in that day.

entries.title: Mark 2:21
segments: No one sews a patch of new cloth on an old garment: otherwise its new filling-up takes from the old [stuff], and there is a worse rent.

entries.title: Mark 2:22
segments: And no one puts new wine into old skins; otherwise the wine bursts the skins, and the wine is poured out, and the skins will be destroyed; but new wine is to be put into new skins.

entries.title: Mark 2:23
segments: And it came to pass that he went on the sabbath through the cornfields; and his disciples began to walk on, plucking the ears.

entries.title: Mark 2:24
segments: And the Pharisees said to him, Behold, why do they on the sabbath what is not lawful?

entries.title: Mark 2:25
segments: And *he* said to them, Have ye never read what David did when he had need and hungered, *he* and those with him,

entries.title: Mark 2:26
segments: how he entered into the house of God, in [the section of] Abiathar [the] high priest, and ate the shew-bread, which it is not lawful unless for the priests to eat, and gave even to those that were with him?

entries.title: Mark 2:27
segments: And he said to them, The sabbath was made on account of man, not man on account of the sabbath;

entries.title: Mark 2:28
segments: so that the Son of man is lord of the sabbath also.
